membership_scope.name: membership_scope
membership_scope.value: ("membership"."role" in ('OWNER','ADMIN') and "membership"."all_branches") or ("membership"."role" = 'CASHIER' and not "membership"."all_branches") or "membership"."role" = 'MANAGER'

qr_shape.name: qr_shape
qr_shape.value: ("qr_code"."kind"='RESTAURANT' and "qr_code"."branch_id" is null and "qr_code"."table_id" is null) or ("qr_code"."kind"='BRANCH' and "qr_code"."branch_id" is not null and "qr_code"."table_id" is null) or ("qr_code"."kind"='TABLE' and "qr_code"."branch_id" is not null and "qr_code"."table_id" is not null)

analytics_product_shape.name: analytics_product_shape
analytics_product_shape.value: ("analytics_event"."kind" in ('PRODUCT_VIEW','CART_ADD') and "analytics_event"."product_id" is not null) or ("analytics_event"."kind" in ('MENU_VIEW','QR_SCAN') and "analytics_event"."product_id" is null)
